title: Match group ownership to a reference file
summary: Use chgrp with the reference flag to copy the group ownership from one file to another.

steps.explain: Use the --reference flag to specify a file whose group ownership will be copied to the target.

placeholders.name: REFERENCE_FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the file with the desired group

rollback.explain: Change the group back to its original value.
